title: September 21 to 27, 2026
summary: Set 14 reveals begin, voting turns fairer and more private, and the synergy engine reads Shift, Bounce, Singer, Self-Discard and Named Companions more accurately.

new.title: Set 14 reveals are live
new.body: The Reveals page is back for Set 14, Hyperia City. By September 27 it held 122 of the set's 204 main cards: every one officially revealed so far. The set's prerelease is on October 16 and its release on October 23.

fixed.title: Only official reveals
fixed.body: An unofficial leaked card was taken down the day it appeared, and new reveals are now checked against the official reveal list before they're published.

fixed.title: Sharing the Reveals page
fixed.body: The Reveals page now has its own title in the browser tab, and links shared in Discord, Slack, iMessage or Twitter preview as the Reveals page instead of the homepage.

fixed.title: Card images
fixed.body: Six cards whose art can't be downloaded now show a placeholder instead of a broken image, and Woody - Jungle Guide's missing image was added.

fixed.title: Fairer, more private voting
fixed.body: Individual votes are no longer publicly readable, the one-vote-per-pair rule can't be sidestepped, and voters on IPv6 connections are no longer counted as one person.

fixed.title: Privacy
fixed.body: The site stopped serving internal vote and traffic analytics files.

engine.title: Shift paid with ink drops
engine.body: Baymax - Amped Up's Shift is now recognized and scored, and Named Companions no longer reads a Shift reminder as a companion.

engine.title: Bounce, Singer and Self-Discard
engine.body: Bounce pairs now respect targeting limits such as "cost 2 or less". Characters that grant themselves Singer now find their songs, and Self-Discard understands "cards in your discard" payoffs and mill.

engine.title: Named Companions
engine.body: Four card names are now read correctly, so Buzz's Arm pairs with the Buzz Lightyear cards and Focused Search with Kevin.

behindTheScenes: Plus 10 behind-the-scenes changes: dependency updates, deploy fixes and tooling fixes.
